Order rows by L1 distance to a point (stable ties)

order_by_l1.Rd

Returns distances and a stable ordering. If rustat_order_by_l1() exists, it is used; otherwise order(dx, seq_along(dx)) provides a deterministic tie-break.

Usage

order_by_l1(X, x0)

Arguments

X

Numeric matrix \(n \times p\). Each row is an observation.

x0

Numeric vector of length \(p\). The query point.

Value

A list with:

  • dx: numeric vector (length \(n\))

  • ord: integer vector of 1-based row indices

See also

order_by_l1_scaled(), dist_l1()

Examples

set.seed(2)
X <- matrix(rnorm(10), 5, 2)
x0 <- c(0, 0)
order_by_l1(X, x0)
#> $dx
#> [1] 1.0293348 0.8928039 1.8275434 3.1148496 0.2190388
#> 
#> $ord
#> [1] 5 2 1 3 4
#>
